scope: Freeze existing runtime algorithm and evidence reuse; not a new submission, model promotion, training or generation run

generation.ttt: Fresh task-specific TTT24 on frozen V7; never Base task adapters
generation.execution: FASTEST_CURRENT_READY_V1; exact-compatible READY dynamic lanes, root-aware 8 or 4+4 and safety profile fallback; do not reinterpret as universal B8/B16
generation.artifact_authority: Generation archive's CONTRACT, identities and additive execution amendments; current Git SHA is not retroactively the original generation SHA

selector.name: HISTORICAL_B_AUG8
selector.formula: support_count - mean(mean_token_nll over eight frozen views)
selector.ties: Canonical view order, completion index, expanded nodes, candidate ID, grid key
selector.sources: Separate Greedy and DFS pools; Top2 per output
selector.numerical_condition: Retain established runtime/batch contract; no hot patch or inference change to running job

reuse.implemented: Exact SHA-bound complete shard reuse; stable-identity adapter reuse; retain active immutable task adapter
reuse.first_priority: Reuse completed B shards only with exact candidate set/index, task adapter, model, tokenizer, context, view and payload identities
reuse.source_generation_scores: Retain token_logprob, cumulative_score=NLL, ancestry and full_arc_logprobs. Extract source-view features on CPU; never relabel as all-view B scores.
reuse.B_reuse_gate: Generated probabilities require matching prompt/token/EOS/model/normalization and matched numerical parity before replacing teacher-forced B values; presently NOT_VALIDATED, so no silent substitution
reuse.missing_scores: Missing is UNKNOWN, not zero and not inferable from another view. No bulk GPU backfill/re-generation under this reuse task.
reuse.retention: Do not delete or rewrite source pools, parent failed jobs, partial shards or node traces.

oracle_only_scope.owner_request: Owner explicitly requests ORC now from frozen pools
oracle_only_scope.boundary: CPU scorer verifies all consumed candidate/cohort/contract hashes and freezes input inventory before designated Eval60 Gold. B algorithm is immutable, runs separately and receives no Gold or oracle feedback.

active_job_handling: Do not hot edit active checkout, auto-rearm, rerun generation, or reset 2026-10-16T04:07:04Z owner deadline. Original bounded job remains under Supervisor.
